environment.stack: docker-compose demo: AegisCore.API(net10.0) + AegisCore.Portal(Next.js16) + PostgreSQL17-alpine + Redis7-alpine

license_overhead_ab.method: identical /api/session, pre-auth token, 5 VUs, direct API, no portal
license_overhead_ab.per_request_db: 1 x SELECT FROM LicenseStates (ToLisTAsync, no cache, no WHERE) + set_config(app.tenant_id)

error_breakdown.finance_executive: 500 pre-existing EF LINQ translation bug (not load)

bottlenecks_ranked: 1. API CPU saturation: Argon2 logins + EF SQL console logging + synchronous PDF/PQC (6/8 cores, plateau ~30 req/s)
2. Transcript PDF generation synchronous: 3s single-user, 30s+ at 50 VUs
3. Login path: Argon2 + GeoIP + user query, 2-8s at 50-100 VUs
4. License per-request DB read: +1 round trip/request non-demo, +2-4ms trivial endpoint
5. OBE N+1 + in-memory aggregation (under-exercised by empty demo data)
6. EF SQL logging at Information level
measurement_limitations: Tiny demo dataset (2 students, 7 courses, 0 OBE/CLO, 0 finance vouchers) under-represents OBE/finance/registration hot paths
k6 default 30s request timeout caps transcript_pdf (p95/p99 = timeout artifact)
dotnet-counters/trace could not attach (DOTNET_EnableDiagnostics=0); GC inferred from memory, not measured
No OpenTelemetry; /metrics exposes only HTTP histograms
pg_stat_statements not enabled (avoided Postgres restart); used pg_stat_database + EXPLAIN ANALYZE + statement logging
Tests through portal proxy + demo-mode license skipped; non-demo adds +1 DB round trip/request
Shared 8-core host: results are a lower bound for single-tenant, upper bound for resources

verdict.p95_crud_300ms_target: NOT MET (session 1.56s, transcript read 3.94s at 100 VUs)
verdict.error_1pct_target: NOT MET (15% - dominated by known data errors, not load)
recommended_queues: A8 EF log level / dead code
